title: Coherent states for the exotic Landau problem and related properties
summary: This work presents a comprehensive study of the exotic Landau model in a two-dimensional noncommutative plane. Beginning with the classical formulation where two conserved quantities $\mathcal{P}_i$ and $\mathcal{K}_i$ are derived, we proceed to the quantum level where these lead to two independent oscillator representations generating bosonic Fock spaces $Γ_{\mathcal{P}}$ and $Γ_{\mathcal{K}}$.
